en: The postcard features a sepia photograph of a large, ornate building with soldiers and guards standing in front of the entrance, some under a canopy. Crowds and a parade-like scene are visible. The text on the front is in both Bulgarian and French: 'Поздравъ отъ Варна. Souvenir de Varna.' and 'Посрѣщането на рускии адмиралъ М. Николаевичъ' which translates to 'Greeting from Varna. Souvenir of Varna.' and 'Reception of Russian Admiral M. Nikolaevich.' Handwritten notes in Bulgarian are also present. The reverse side is a typical divided-back for addresses and contains handwriting in Bulgarian.
